sql_query.query: UPDATE _contributions SET status = 'CONFIRMED', confirmed_by = $2, updated_at = $3::timestamptz WHERE id = $1 AND status = 'PENDING' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM _memberships m WHERE m.circle_id = _contributions.circle_id AND m.user_id = $2 AND m.role IN ('OWNER', 'TREASURER')) RETURNING id, circle_id, status
INSERT INTO _activity (id, circle_id, actor_id, type, message, created_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 'CONTRIBUTION_CONFIRMED', 'Contribution confirmed', $4::timestamptz)
